payload.reason: The evidence provides specific statistical improvements of the PAMPO model over existing alternatives in named entity recognition, including recall and F1 measures.

claims.text: PAMPO improves named entity recognition by at least 0.25 over AlchemyAPI, Rembrandt, and Zemanta.
PAMPO achieves significantly higher recall and F1 measures compared to AlchemyAPI, Rembrandt, and Zemanta.
PAMPO's performance in the HAREM corpus is at least as good as the best existing systems, and better when excluding dates and numeric expressions.
The second phase of the PAMPO process increases the quality measure from 0.72 to 0.87.
